title: Why More Context Makes AI Hallucinate (The Distraction Paradox) #shorts
caption:
Why does feeding MORE context to ChatGPT make it hallucinate? 🧠⚡

It’s called the Context Distraction Paradox.

When building production RAG, dumping Top-10 chunks into your prompt often degrades generation:
1️⃣ Attention Dilution: Self-attention weights must sum to 100% via Softmax. Adding noisy chunks mathematically dilutes the model's focus on verified facts.
2️⃣ Lost in the Middle: LLMs suffer from U-shaped attention curves—retrieved facts buried in the middle third see an immediate performance drop of over 30%.
3️⃣ The Production Fix: Run a Cross-Encoder re-ranker, apply strict score thresholds, and keep your context budget minimal by placing high-precision chunks at the prompt edges.
